document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
As you wander the banks of the North Hanninah alone, you 
hear the crackle of walkers in the woods ahead. At first, your 
heart leaps at finding other people, but then you remember the 
cruel lessons of the Big Woods. They may not be friendly.

You hide and wait for them. A moment later a party of men 
appears—undersized  men,  with  unnaturally  gray  skin.  One 
holds the severed head of a woodsman.

You duck your head, hoping they will not see you. Make a Stealth 
roll: if you succeed, go to 111; if you fail, go to 495.
